subject: Prod cutover checklist & telemetry smoke validation — Nimbus private deployment
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Rivera <carlos.rivera@nimbus.com>, sre-team@nimbus.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Prod cutover checklist & telemetry smoke validation — Nimbus private deployment

Hi Carlos / Nimbus SRE,

We're on track for the private deployment cutover next Friday (2026-02-20). Attached is the runbook v2 and the smoke test script we'll execute during the validation window. This thread is to confirm owners for each pre-cutover check and to lock the telemetry/alerting acceptance criteria.

High level plan (2-hour maintenance window):
- 00:00–00:30: Pre-cutover: final config push, allowlist & firewall verification, DB traffic mirroring offload
- 00:30–01:00: Cutover: route shift to Redwood private endpoint; load-balancer update
- 01:00–01:30: Smoke validation: latency/throughput smoke tests, KV cache verification, prefix caching sanity
- 01:30–02:00: Post-checks and rollback hold (if needed)

Pre-cutover owners (please confirm):
- Networking & firewall allowlist: Nimbus networking (networking@nimbus.com) — confirm IPs in attached networking-allowlist.csv
- Model serving config & runtime validation: Dev Patel (dev_patel@redwood.ai)
- Observability/telemetry acceptance: Hannah Schmitt (hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai) — need tracing + token-level cost metrics to be live
- Rollback/incident lead: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai)

Telemetry/acceptance criteria (Hannah, suggest anything missing):
- Ingest of application traces within 3 minutes of cutover; no missing spans for 90% sample calls
- Token-rate and per-route latency dashboards populated within 5 minutes
- Error rate < 0.5% for 15 minutes following cutover

Attachments: Nimbus_prod_cutover_runbook_v2.pdf (runbook), smoke_test_script.sh (executable test harness), networking-allowlist.csv

Carlos — can you confirm the maintenance window and that your infra has the required routing/flotation prepared? Also confirm whether Nimbus wants us to perform a canary (5% traffic) before full shift.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0189

From: Carlos Rivera <carlos.rivera@nimbus.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, sre-team@nimbus.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 12:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prod cutover checklist & telemetry smoke validation — Nimbus private deployment

Kimberly,

Thanks — maintenance window 02/20 22:00–00:00 UTC (your local Friday night) works for us. Networking team confirmed the IPs in networking-allowlist.csv and will apply the ACLs 1 hour before the window.

We prefer a staged canary: start at 5% for 15 minutes, then ramp to 50% for 20 minutes, then full shift. Our concerns: session affinity across the LB (we run sticky sessions for a small set of routes) and backend TLS SNI mapping.

I asked our networking lead to call out any NAT/policy changes — cc'd networking@nimbus.com. We'll also have our SRE Slack channel monitored during the window.

- Carlos
Carlos Rivera
Head of Platform — Nimbus Systems
carlos.rivera@nimbus.com

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Carlos Rivera <carlos.rivera@nimbus.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prod cutover checklist & telemetry smoke validation — Nimbus private deployment

Thanks for the updates, Carlos. Notes from infra side: 

- LB session affinity: we will mark the small sticky-route subset in the routing rules so session cookies map correctly. I'll push the routing rule change in the pre-cutover step and leave a 5-min verification window.
- TLS/SNI: certificate chain validated in staging; production certs uploaded to the private deployment's cert store. Please confirm that the SNI names in your LB match the cert SANs.
- KV cache warm-up: I'll run a 10-minute cache warm-up script before the canary. The smoke_test_script.sh has a --warmup flag.
- IP allowlist: I noticed Nimbus included /28 ranges; we added them to the firewall accept list in the runbook notes.

I'll be on the call for the whole window. My checklist items are marked in the attached runbook.

Dev Patel
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Prod cutover checklist & telemetry smoke validation — Nimbus private deployment

Quick post-cutover summary (observability & smoke results):

- Canary (5% -> 50% -> 100%) executed as planned by 22:47 UTC. No rollback required.
- Tracing: spans are flowing into our tracing backend within ~45 seconds of first sampled call (meets acceptance)
- Token-level metrics: per-route token rate dashboards updated within 3 minutes; cost telemetry shows expected uplift during the canary window
- Latency: p50 for core inference route 182ms (target < 200ms), p90 410ms (target < 500ms)
- Error rate: 0.23% across sampled traffic in the 30 minutes post-cutover (target <0.5%)
- Smoke tests: smoke_test_script.sh completed; evidence attached: smoke_results_20260220.log (referenced in runbook)

Outstanding items:
- Minor LB route mismatch for one static asset path — Carlos' networking team to patch routing rule (low priority, non-blocking)
- Add an automated synthetic that covers prefix-caching regressions (Hannah -> ticket INF-4821 created)

Thanks everyone. Filing the post-cutover runbook notes back into Confluence and closing the maintenance window.

Hannah Schmitt
Observability Lead | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
